text: The Video Book is a project that re-imagines traditional photo books by incorporating screens that play videos.
The project was created by Anton.
The project was launched on Kickstarter.
The funding goal for the project was $49,429.
$458 was pledged to the project.
The funding period for the project was from September 2, 2024, to November 1, 2024.
The project's funding was unsuccessful as the goal was not reached by the deadline.
The project is based in Toronto, Canada.
The Video Book is a groundbreaking innovation that combines traditional photo albums with high-resolution screens.
Each page of the Video Book features high-resolution screens that are pre-loaded with videos.
Users can register on the website to create their personalized Video Book.
Users can upload 8 videos for their personalized Video Book.
The Video Book will be crafted and shipped directly to the user after video upload.
